meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你对 NanoClaw 项目的自定义修改，生成一份可重用的迁移指南。之后，它会用这份指南在干净的官方代码上重新应用你的修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你需要将自定义过的 NanoClaw 项目升级到上游新版本时触发。技能会先检查你的修改范围，然后引导你完成提取和升级两个阶段。

say.text: 帮我提取 NanoClaw 的自定义修改并生成迁移指南。
say.note: 技能会分析你的代码并生成指南。

say.text: 用已有的迁移指南升级我的 NanoClaw 项目。
say.note: 如果已有指南，技能会直接进入升级阶段。

say.text: 检查我的 NanoClaw 项目是否有冲突风险。
say.note: 技能会评估修改范围并建议最佳路径。

howto.what_en: This skill extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to the upstream version by reapplying your customizations on a clean base, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to a new upstream version. The skill assesses your changes and guides you through extraction and upgrade phases.

say_en.text: Extract my NanoClaw customizations and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze your code and create the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw project using the existing migration guide.
say_en.note: If a guide exists, the skill will skip to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Check my NanoClaw project for potential conflicts.
say_en.note: The skill will assess the scope and suggest the best approach.
